tasker.aspect_ratio_warning.title: 🚨 Warning: Resolution requirement not met! 🚨
tasker.aspect_ratio_warning.desc: 💡 The game only offers an aspect-ratio option, not a resolution setting. Fully close the game, restore a windowed 1920x1080 window with either method below, then run the task again:
tasker.aspect_ratio_warning.requirement_: Current window resolution is not supported; restore a windowed 1920x1080 window (other valid modes: 3840x2160, 2560x1440, 1600x900, 1280x720)
The game records a window size of %dx%d, which differs from the actual window because the border was dragged. There is no in-game resolution option; the game must be restarted to restore it
tasker.aspect_ratio_warning.full_screen_: The game is in fullscreen mode but the monitor's physical aspect ratio is not 16:9. Relaunch the game in windowed mode
tasker.aspect_ratio_warning.fix_via_app: Option 1 (recommended): launch the game through this app; the pre-launch setup automatically resets the window to windowed 1920x1080
tasker.aspect_ratio_warning.fix_via_shor: Option 2: right-click the game shortcut > Properties, and append to Target: -screen-width 1920 -screen-height 1080 -screen-fullscreen 0, then launch via that shortcut
tasker.aspect_ratio_warning.fix_no_drag: Do not drag the window border after restoring; otherwise the game must be restarted again.
